parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain the reason for the difference in colour of the two complexes $[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{3+}$ and $[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_5\text{SCN}]^{2+}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
Use information in Table 3.2 to calculate the value of the equilibrium constant, $K_{\text{c}}$, for the following reaction.

$$[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_5\text{SCN}]^{2+} + \text{F}^- \rightleftharpoons [\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_5\text{F}]^{2+} + \text{SCN}^-$$

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
A few drops of $\text{KF(aq)}$ are added to a solution of $[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{3+}\text{(aq)}$, followed by a few drops of $\text{KSCN(aq)}$.

Use information in Table 3.2 to describe any observations after each addition. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
Hydrated compound $\mathbf{J}$, $\text{K}_3\text{Fe}(\text{C}_2\text{O}_4)_3\cdot x\text{H}_2\text{O}$, contains the green complex ion $[\text{Fe}(\text{C}_2\text{O}_4)_3]^{3-}$.

The value of $x$ can be determined by titration of a sample of $\mathbf{J}$ with acidified $\text{MnO}_4^-$ ions.

$\text{MnO}_4^-$ ions oxidise $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$ ions in acidic conditions.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Write half equations for the oxidation of $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$ ions and for the reduction of $\text{MnO}_4^-$ ions.

- oxidation of $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$

- reduction of $\text{MnO}_4^-$

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
A student prepares a solution containing $0.100\text{ g}$ of $\mathbf{J}$.

The student titrates this solution with $0.0200\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ acidified $\text{KMnO}_4\text{(aq)}$. The titre obtained is $12.20\text{ cm}^3$.

Assume all of the $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$ ions are oxidised.

Calculate the value of $x$ in $\text{K}_3\text{Fe}(\text{C}_2\text{O}_4)_3\cdot x\text{H}_2\text{O}$.

Give your answer to the nearest whole number. Show your working.

[$M_{\text{r}}$: $\text{K}_3\text{Fe}(\text{C}_2\text{O}_4)_3$, 437.1]
